failed.issue: 500 Internal Server Error when mutual like triggers first-time match creation. ValueError: 'ObjectId' object is not iterable during response serialization.
failed.evidence: Traceback in /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log: fastapi/encoders.py -> ValueError([TypeError("'ObjectId' object is not iterable")]). Root cause: server.py line ~464 inserts `doc` via `db.matches.insert_one(doc)` which mutates doc in-place adding _id ObjectId, then returns `{'match': doc, ...}` which FastAPI cannot JSON-serialize.

action_items: Fix /api/swipe mutual match response: after `await db.matches.insert_one(doc)`, either pop `_id` from doc (`doc.pop('_id', None)`) or build a fresh dict without _id before returning. Same pattern should be verified for any other insert_one paths that return the inserted doc.

Retest full swipe->match->messages flow after fix; the match may have been partially inserted during failing test (verify no dangling matches without response). Also verify subsequent duplicate-swipe path (existing match branch) works – it uses find_one with {_id:0} so likely OK.

Not tested end-to-end due to blocker: GET /api/matches with actual match, POST /api/messages, GET /api/messages/{match_id}, WS broadcast on new message. Frontend Discover/Match modal/Chat pages not exercised end-to-end (depend on match creation).
